spell.suchki.firebolt.desc: Projectile: 6 fire damage, sets the target on fire for 3 s.
spell.suchki.flames.desc: Channel: a 5-block cone of fire, ~6 damage per second, ignites.
spell.suchki.ice_shard.desc: Projectile: 7 frost damage, Slowness II for 3 s and freezing.
spell.suchki.chain_lightning.desc: Strikes the target for 8 damage and jumps to 3 more enemies (×0.8 each). Overcharge adds jumps.
spell.suchki.frost_nova.desc: A wave of cold around you (radius 6): 6 damage, Slowness III for 4 s.
spell.suchki.fireball.desc: Explodes on impact (radius 3.5): up to 14 damage, fire, knockback. Does not break blocks.
spell.suchki.meteor_shower.desc: Ritual: 8 meteors (more when overcharged) fall on the target area over 4 s, 9 damage each in radius 2.5.
spell.suchki.healing.desc: Channel: heals you for ~2 health per second.
spell.suchki.ward.desc: Channel: damage from the front is reduced by 70%. Each blocked point costs 2 mana.
spell.suchki.heal_other.desc: Heals the creature you aim at for 8 health. Undead take 6 damage instead.
spell.suchki.cure.desc: Removes all harmful effects, puts out fire and heals a little.
spell.suchki.rejuvenation.desc: Regeneration II for 10 s for you and allies within 8 blocks.
spell.suchki.healing_circle.desc: Ritual: a circle of radius 4 for 12 s. Allies heal 1 health per second, undead take 1 damage.
spell.suchki.undying.desc: For 60 s: a fatal blow is cancelled once — half health, regeneration and absorption.
spell.suchki.candlelight.desc: For 3 min a light follows you — no more dark caves.
spell.suchki.smite.desc: A bolt of light: 5 damage, ×2.5 against undead and sets them on fire.
spell.suchki.flash.desc: A blinding flash: enemies within 7 blocks are blinded for 5 s and lose their target.
spell.suchki.sunbeam.desc: Channel: a 24-block beam, ~6 damage per second; ×2.5 against undead and ignites them.
spell.suchki.blessing.desc: Strength I and Resistance I for 45 s for you and allies within 8 blocks.
spell.suchki.sanctuary.desc: Ritual: a zone of radius 6 for 15 s. Undead burn, enemies are pushed out, allies regenerate.
spell.suchki.judgement.desc: Ritual: a pillar of light strikes the target point — 18 damage in radius 3 (×1.5 vs undead), blindness.
spell.suchki.shadow_bolt.desc: A shadow projectile: 5 damage and Wither for 4 s.
spell.suchki.drain_life.desc: Channel: a 16-block beam, ~4 damage per second; 60% of it heals you.
spell.suchki.curse.desc: For 15 s the target takes 25% more damage, is weakened and slowed.
spell.suchki.shadow_step.desc: Teleports you to the aimed spot (up to 20 blocks) or behind an enemy, 2 s of invisibility.
spell.suchki.raise_dead.desc: Summon: 2 undead allies for 60 s (3 when strongly overcharged).
spell.suchki.darkness.desc: A cloud of darkness (radius 4) for 8 s at the aimed spot: enemies get blindness, darkness, wither and slowness.
spell.suchki.soul_harvest.desc: Ritual: enemies within 12 blocks take 14 damage and Wither II, you heal for each.
spell.suchki.stoneflesh.desc: +4 armor and +2 armor toughness for 90 s (doubled when strongly overcharged).
spell.suchki.telekinesis.desc: Channel: pulls items and experience along your gaze (up to 24 blocks) and small creatures.
spell.suchki.featherfall.desc: Slow Falling and Jump Boost for 60 s.
spell.suchki.blink.desc: Instantly teleports you 10 blocks forward (not through walls).
spell.suchki.deep_breath.desc: Water Breathing, Dolphin's Grace and Conduit Power for 3 min.
spell.suchki.paralyze.desc: Projectile: the target can't move or deal damage for 5 s (except bosses).
spell.suchki.earthquake.desc: Ritual: 3 waves in radius 8 — 7 damage each to grounded enemies, knocks them up and slows.
spell.suchki.fear.desc: Enemies within 4 blocks of the aimed spot flee for 8 s and don't attack.
spell.suchki.calm.desc: Mobs within 4 blocks of the aimed spot won't attack players for 20 s unless hit.
spell.suchki.invisibility.desc: Invisibility for 30 s; mobs chasing you lose track of you.
spell.suchki.frenzy.desc: Mobs within 5 blocks of the aimed spot fight each other for 15 s.
spell.suchki.mirror_image.desc: Creates a double of you for 12 s — nearby enemies attack it. You turn invisible briefly.
spell.suchki.mass_hysteria.desc: Ritual: all enemies within 16 blocks flee for 12 s and are weakened.
spell.suchki.bound_blade.desc: A spectral sword (like netherite) for 2 min. Sharpness V when strongly overcharged.
spell.suchki.familiar.desc: Summon: a wolf ally for 90 s (two when strongly overcharged).
spell.suchki.bound_tool.desc: A pickaxe, axe or shovel — depending on the block you look at — with Efficiency III for 3 min.
spell.suchki.spirit_blades.desc: Summon: 3 flying spirits with blades for 30 s.
spell.suchki.spectral_steed.desc: Summon: a fast saddled horse for 5 min; vanishes when nobody rides it.
spell.suchki.recall.desc: Ritual (3 s): teleports you to your respawn point — bed or anchor, otherwise world spawn.
spell.suchki.iron_guardian.desc: Summon: an iron golem ally for 60 s (two when strongly overcharged).
